lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiNb3(OF)4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb in octahedral coordination by 4 F and 2 O neighbors, and Li in octahedral coordination by 4 F and 2 O neighbors. The connectivity forms a three-dimensional network, with corner- and edge-sharing between Nb octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Li octahedra. A 2-periodic component with reduced dimensionality also appears in the analysis.
